title: Fleur-de-Lis Dreamscape
description: A woman in a blue and white patterned dress stands on rocky shore holding a red orb with a golden fleur-de-lis. An astronaut walks along a glowing white path across turquoise water toward a large cluster of transparent bubbles containing miniature scenes, all dominated by a giant golden fleur-de-lis symbol in the sky. Pyramids and a distant figure appear in the background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a woman in a long blue and white dress standing on rocky shore holding a red orb with golden fleur-de-lis, while an astronaut in purple suit walks along a glowing path across turquoise water toward a massive cluster of transparent bubbles filled with tiny worlds, centered around a giant golden fleur-de-lis symbol floating in a purple sky with clouds, distant orange pyramids and a small figure visible on a mountain, whimsical and dreamlike atmosphere
